name: F. H. Ertel
role: Belfield businessman and Republican; Bismarck Journal business manager
bio: F. H. 'Fred' Ertel was a Belfield businessman whose real estate firm, Ertel & Houk, was getting a new office in March 1884. He was active in the 1884 Republican county conventions, where the Cow Boy called him the man best fitted to represent the county. In September 1884 he became business manager and assistant editor of the Bismarck Journal, and in November 1885 the paper said he was making a success of a pictorial paper.
